errors.INSUFFICIENT_PROFILE: There isn't enough in your profile to build a resume from yet. It's {completeness, number, ::percent scale/0.01} complete, and what's still missing is: {missing}.
errors.UNPARSEABLE_JOB_DESCRIPTION: We couldn't make sense of that job posting. Only {skillsFound, plural, =0 {no skills} =1 {one skill} other {# skills}} came out of it, which isn't enough to tailor anything to.
errors.CONFLICTING_PREFERENCES: The content you've pinned needs about {pinnedPages, number} pages, and the limit is set to {maxPages, plural, =1 {one page} other {# pages}}.
errors.ALL_PROVIDERS_UNAVAILABLE: None of the AI providers answered. Nothing was lost — your profile is untouched.
errors.PAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Your content came to {actual, plural, =1 {one page} other {# pages}} and the limit is {limit, plural, =1 {one} other {#}}. It was already shortened as far as it goes.
errors.REWRITE_VALIDATION_FAILED: A rewrite changed something it shouldn't have, so it was thrown away and your own wording kept.
errors.EMBEDDING_UNAVAILABLE: Skill matching is unavailable right now.
errors.PDF_NOT_TEXT_BASED: That PDF is a scan rather than text, so there's nothing to read out of it. A PDF exported from a word processor works.
errors.PDF_ENCRYPTED: That PDF is password-protected. Save an unprotected copy and upload that.
errors.EXTRACTION_EMPTY: Nothing readable came out of that file.
errors.EXTRACTION_TIMEOUT: Reading that file took too long and was stopped.
errors.LANGUAGE_UNDETECTED: We couldn't tell what language that's written in. Closest guesses: {detectedCandidates}.
errors.PROFILE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You've reached today's limit of {limit, plural, =1 {one profile} other {# profiles}}.
errors.ANONYMOUS_SESSION_EXPIRED: This session ended, two hours after your last activity here.
errors.ATOM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You're at {current, number} of {limit, plural, =1 {one item} other {# items}}.
errors.NO_ANONYMOUS_PROFILE: There's no unsaved profile to claim.
errors.PROFILE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This account already has a profile.
errors.GENERATION_ARTIFACT_EXPIRED: That file is past its 14 days and has been deleted. Everything it was built from is still here, so it can be made again.
errors.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: That request couldn't be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: That isn't here. It may have been deleted in another tab.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This changed somewhere else while you were working on it.
errors.PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: That change was sent without saying which version it was based on, so it wasn't applied.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of what was sent couldn't be accepted: {fields}.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The app sent a request this address doesn't accept. That's a fault on our side, not something you did.
errors.NOT_ACCEPTABLE: The app asked for a format the server can't produce. That's a fault on our side, not something you did.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The app sent data in a format the server doesn't accept. That's a fault on our side, not something you did.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something broke on our side. Nothing you'd entered was lost.
errors.UNEXPECTED_ERROR: Something went wrong, and the response didn’t say what.
errors.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: We couldn't reach the server. Your connection may be down.

Landing.tagline: Build your profile once, generate a tailored resume for every job posting.
Landing.intro: Your professional history is structured data, not a document. AtomCV keeps it that way, then produces a resume for each posting from that data — inside a page limit that is calculated rather than hoped for.

pageLimit.title: A page limit that holds
pageLimit.body: Every item's height is measured in the real template. Selection is solved as an optimization problem, so the limit is a constraint rather than a request.

deterministic.title: Same input, same output
deterministic.body: Scoring and selection run in code, not in a language model. Two runs of the same posting produce the same resume.

noInvention.title: Nothing invented
noInvention.body: The model never writes free content. It chooses from what you wrote and rewrites narrowly, and every rewrite is checked for lost numbers, changed names and added technologies.

formats.title: Content independent of format
formats.body: The same profile renders to PDF, DOCX or source. No formatting is baked into your data.

transparency.title: Reasons you can inspect
transparency.body: Every item shows its score and the keywords it matched. Content left out is listed and can be added back in one click.

Landing.openSourceNote: Free and open source under the MIT licence. Run by one person, with no service guarantee — if it is ever shut down, notice comes at least 30 days in advance.

save.conflict: You changed this item in another tab.

atom.marksDropped: Saving this will keep the words and drop the highlighting on them. The editor that keeps it is not built yet.

active.label: Available
active.hint: Turn off to keep it in your profile without ever using it in a resume.

alwaysInclude.label: Always include
alwaysInclude.hint: Selection may not drop it, even when space is tight.

verbatim.label: Never reword
verbatim.hint: Your wording is used exactly as written, with no rewriting.

skills.label: Skills
skills.hint: Canonical names used to match this against a posting.

metrics.label: Numbers
metrics.hint: Figures a rewrite is not allowed to lose or change.

properNouns.label: Names
properNouns.hint: People, products and companies a rewrite may not invent or alter.

variants.staleExplained: The wording this was based on has changed since. Regenerating it is not built yet — editing it here is the way to bring it up to date.

Legal.draftNotice: This document is a draft. It lists what must be covered and is not yet a published policy. It must be completed and reviewed before the service accepts real users.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: Profile content taken from your CV, your email address, and usage metrics.
privacy.whyBody: To generate resumes, manage your account, and improve the service.
privacy.shareBody: AI providers receive the content needed to analyse a posting and rewrite your own wording. The current list of providers, what is sent to each, and whether any free tier may use that data for model training must be stated here explicitly. Email is sent through Resend, files are stored on Cloudflare R2, and analytics are anonymous and cookie-free.
privacy.retentionBody: Account data for as long as the account exists. Anonymous sessions expire two hours after your last activity. Generated PDFs are kept 14 days, or indefinitely if you archive them. Logs are kept 30 days.
privacy.rightsBody: Access, correction, deletion, and export of your data in JSON and Markdown.
privacy.deletionBody: Deleting your account removes your profile, generated documents, sessions and connected accounts. It is permanent and cannot be undone.
privacy.contactBody: Contact details to be added before publication.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.noGuaranteeBody: AtomCV helps you present the experience you already have. It does not promise interviews or offers.
terms.estimate: The fit report is an estimate
terms.estimateBody: It shows how well your resume reflects the terms used in a posting. It does not reproduce the behaviour of any particular applicant tracking system, and real hiring decisions depend on far more than keyword coverage.
terms.accuracyBody: Review what you send. The generated document is built from content you provided, and you remain responsible for it.
terms.abuseBody: Accounts used to attack the service, to extract model output for unrelated purposes, or to generate content about people other than yourself may be suspended.
terms.noSlaBody: The service is free and offered as a personal project. There is no uptime guarantee and no support commitment. If it is discontinued, notice will be given at least 30 days in advance, and your data will remain exportable during that period.
